# SCUNet architecture

`network_scunet.py` is the retained upstream SCUNet architecture from
https://github.com/cszn/SCUNet, unmodified. The original Apache-2.0 licence and
copyright attribution are preserved in LICENSE.

The separately downloaded model was
https://github.com/cszn/KAIR/releases/download/v1.0/scunet_color_real_psnr.pth.
Weights are intentionally outside Git, in the private data directory's weights/.
The original runtime and model checksum records remain with local batch metadata.
